definitions.gloss: rough chopping; cutting into large, irregular pieces
definitions.explanation: a cutting technique where ingredients are cut into large chunks without concern for uniform size or shape

examples.japanese: ⟦{鶏肉|とりにく}→鶏肉：02919_toriniku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぶつ{切|ぎ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: You can just roughly chop the vegetables.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}ねぎ→長ねぎ：14827_naganegi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぶつ{切|ぎ}りにして⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: Cut the green onion into chunks and put it in the pot.

notes:
USAGE:
Used for stews, hot pots and simmered dishes, where the pieces cook down and a rough look is fine: ⟦{鶏肉|とりにく}→鶏肉：02919_toriniku⟧のぶつ{切|ぎ}り, ⟦{長|なが}→長〜：03963_naga⟧ねぎのぶつ{切|ぎ}り. Also used of fish or octopus cut in chunks, as in タコのぶつ{切|ぎ}り.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{角切|かくぎ}り→角切り：08086_kakugiri⟧ - dicing into even cubes; ぶつ{切|ぎ}り pieces are large and uneven
- ⟦{乱切|らんぎ}り→乱切り：08067_rangiri⟧ - roll cut: turning the vegetable between diagonal cuts to make irregular wedges
- ⟦{細切|ほそぎ}り→細切り：08571_hosogiri⟧ - thin strips
- ⟦{千切|せんぎ}り→千切り：07473_sengiri⟧ - very fine shreds
